steps.caption: Open Capture and the Anil note under Recent captures.
Scroll to Extracted information. Each item has a status: For review, Saved, Confirmed, Corrected or Rejected.
Open 'Confirm, edit, reject…' on Preferred location.
Kharadi is right — Confirm.
It now shows Confirmed.
Edit: Anil meant 20,000 sq ft carpet. Open the Area item.
Type the value and choose Area basis: Carpet.
Save correction. The original words stay; the item is marked Corrected and logged.
Link: attach the area to Marigold Loop Technologies.
Link to record. It is linked, never merged.
Ask: the year of 'by September' is unknown. Open Move-in target.
Type the question for the client and press Request clarification — it becomes a task for you.
Create: when a person or company is not in CRE OS yet, 'Create (for approval)' proposes a new one.
Correction history lists every change you made here.
Now the Review queue: Capture → Pending reviews.
Only what needs a person, grouped by reason.
Categories: uncertain company or contact matches, potential duplicates, conflicting values, missing units or dates, unverified lease details, material changes.
Conflicting commercial values: the revised ₹95 quote and the Hinglish 'Unko Kharadi' location are here.
Reject: 'Unko Kharadi' is a misreading. Open it.
Reject. Nothing on any record changes; the item is just marked Rejected.
Material changes requiring approval link to Review, where record changes are approved.
